text: On 2026-07-31, a deploy removed the cache warmup step. This step normally preloads the cache before traffic increases. Without this step, backend servers received full traffic before their caches were ready. Between 14:02 and 14:31 UTC, 12% of API requests failed with HTTP 502 errors. The team identified the cause and reverted the deploy at 14:27 UTC. All requests returned to normal within minutes after the revert. No customer data was affected during this incident. We will add a check to the deploy pipeline. This check will confirm that the cache warmup step runs before traffic increases. We apologize for the disruption this incident caused.
